A particular type of unarmed '''plasma mining vehicle''' was in use on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]<ref name="BFN" /> in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].<ref name="NEC">''Battle for Naboo'' itself refers to its events taking place during the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]], an event ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates to [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].</ref> The vehicles were driven by [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] [[Engine/Legends|engines]] and collected [[Plasma/Legends|plasma]] by [[Mining/Legends|burrowing underground]] and lifting the plasma out. Three were used by a [[Unidentified mine operator|mine director]] to collect plasma at a [[Plasma mining camp|mining camp]] affiliated with the [[Borvo]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt's]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]] [[Nal Raka Criminal Empire|organization]]<ref name="BFN" /> and the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]].<ref name="EG">{{StoryCite|story=End Game|book=Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace (novelization)|bformatted=''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'' novelization, 2012 edition}}</ref> The miners and the mine itself were destroyed during an [[Search for Captain Kael|incident]] with the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]]. [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Gavyn Sykes/Legends|Gavyn Sykes]] had stumbled onto the camp while it was under attack by the [[Trade Federation Droid Army/Legends|Trade Federation Droid Army]]. After driving off the Federation [[Armored Assault Tank/Legends|tanks]], Sykes contacted the mine operator, who warned the lieutenant to back off. Sykes was not deterred by the warning and defended himself when the remaining [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]] attacked him.<ref name="BFN" />

==Behind the scenes==
These vehicles were created for the [[2000]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Episode I: Battle for Naboo]]'' and are only in one mission. It is necessary to destroy the vehicles and the rest of the camp before proceeding in the mission.<ref name="BFN" />
